fields.field: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with numerator and denominator per cohort (not percentage alone), using the paper's wording and standard HPO term if identifiable, with resolvable PMID or DOI

Most discriminating findings that are present in most affected individuals but uncommon in usually confused disorders, including names of those differential disorders and confidence in the distinction
Findings looked for and found absent in affected individuals (features arguing against the diagnosis)
Phenotype differences or correlations by variant type, variant position, age, or sex
Contradictory findings reported by one paper and explicitly contradicted by another
